 "command": "mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-46473b61.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Recover the zeroed rectangular patch from the vertically mirrored grid."""
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 0 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
    return [[grid[len(grid) - 1 - r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
PY
